title: Energy-Flow Cosmology: Empirical Validation of the EFC Screening Model Against the Radial Acceleration Relation
abstract: Multi-scale empirical validation of the EFC screening model: SPARC RAR fit (k=0.415, g†=2.51e-10 m/s², sigma_int~0.14 dex), KiDS-1000 lensing improvement, Bullet Cluster entropy-gradient interpretation, and H0 tension resolution via a_G=0.094. Phase-gain C=k/a_G=4.4 connects galactic and cosmological scales.
